notes.title: Update - Vive Index and Oculus Quest 2 link compatibility added
notes.content:
Dear supporters! 
My first big update is here, and it brings the following:
- Vive Index controllers support
- Oculus Quest 2 via Link support
- removed 2GG of bloat from the UE4, which means the game only takes 500 MB of space, instead of whooping 2.5GB previously. Sorry, I should have never uploaded it so big.

Please join our Facebook group if you have any questions!
